英文情景对话:
Emma: Good morning. I'd like to check in for flight CA981 to New York.
Jack: Good morning, ma'am. May I see your passport and ticket, please?
Emma: Here you are.
Jack: Thank you. How many pieces of luggage are you checking in?
Emma: Two pieces. Could I have a window seat, please?
Jack: Of course. Here are your boarding pass and baggage claim tags.
Emma: Thank you very much. Will my flight be on time?
Jack: I'm afraid there may be a one-hour delay due to the weather. Please listen for announcements.
Emma: Oh no, that's bad. Will it still depart today?
Jack: Yes, it will. The delay is about one hour.
Emma: Is my luggage overweight?
Jack: Let me check. It's 2 kg over, so there's an extra fee of 50 dollars.
Emma: Here's my card. Wait — I just heard on the news that the flight might be cancelled.
Jack: Let me check the system. I'm sorry, the flight has been cancelled due to the storm.
Emma: What? Then how do I get to New York?
Jack: Don't worry. We'll put you on the next available flight tomorrow morning at 9.
Emma: That's a long wait. Will the airline cover tonight's hotel?
Jack: Yes, we'll arrange a hotel near the airport and provide a meal voucher.
Emma: Thank you for your help.
中文翻译:
艾玛：早上好，我想办理飞往纽约的CA981航班的登机手续。
杰克：早上好，女士。请出示您的护照和机票好吗？
艾玛：给您。
杰克：谢谢。您要托运几件行李？
艾玛：两件。请给我靠窗的座位好吗？
杰克：当然可以。这是您的登机牌和行李托运凭证。
艾玛：非常感谢。航班会准时起飞吗？
杰克：恐怕会因天气原因延误一小时左右，请留意广播通知。
艾玛：哎呀，那可糟了。今天还会飞吗？
杰克：会的，大约延误一小时。
艾玛：我的行李超重了吗？
杰克：我称一下。超重2公斤，需要补50美元。
艾玛：这是我的卡。等等——我刚听新闻说航班可能取消了。
杰克：我查一下系统。很抱歉，航班因暴风雨已经取消了。
艾玛：什么？那我怎么去纽约？
杰克：别担心，我们会把您安排到明天上午9点的下一班航班。
艾玛：那要等很久。航空公司会负责今晚的酒店吗？
杰克：会的，我们会安排机场附近的酒店，并提供餐券。
艾玛：谢谢你的帮助。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Good afternoon. Here are my passport and boarding pass.
Jack: Good afternoon. What's the purpose of your visit?
Emma: I'm here on business.
Jack: How long will you be staying?
Emma: About two weeks.
Jack: Do you have anything to declare?
Emma: No, I have nothing to declare.
Jack: Please open this bag for a quick check.
Emma: Sure, no problem.
Jack: Ma'am, what's this in the sealed container?
Emma: Oh, that's some homemade sauce my mother packed for me.
Jack: I'm sorry, but meat and food products aren't allowed into the country.
Emma: Really? I had no idea. What will happen to it?
Jack: We'll have to confiscate it. Please declare any food next time.
Emma: I understand. Thank you for letting me know.
Jack: All clear. You can go. Have a nice stay.
Emma: Thank you very much.
中文翻译:
艾玛：下午好。这是我的护照和登机牌。
杰克：下午好。您此行的目的是什么？
艾玛：我是来出差的。
杰克：您打算停留多长时间？
艾玛：大约两周。
杰克：您有需要申报的物品吗？
艾玛：没有，我没有需要申报的物品。
杰克：请打开这个包做一下快速检查。
艾玛：好的，没问题。
杰克：女士，这个密封罐里是什么？
艾玛：哦，那是我妈妈给我装的一些自制酱料。
杰克：抱歉，肉类和食品不允许入境。
艾玛：真的吗？我完全不知道。它会怎么处理？
杰克：我们必须没收。下次请务必申报任何食品。
艾玛：我明白了，谢谢您告诉我。
杰克：检查完毕，您可以走了，祝您在此愉快。
艾玛：非常感谢。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello. I'd like a ticket to Beijing, please.
Jack: Sure. Which one would you like, the high-speed train or the regular one?
Emma: The high-speed one, please. What time does the next train leave?
Jack: The next train leaves at 10:30 from Platform 6.
Emma: Great. Could I have a window seat?
Jack: Certainly. That'll be 230 yuan. Cash or card?
Emma: Card, please.
Jack: All right, here is your ticket. Have a good trip.
Emma: What if I miss the train?
Jack: You can change your ticket to a later one at the ticket office with a small fee.
Emma: Thanks. Oh, is the 10:30 train on time?
Jack: I'm sorry, there's an announcement — the train is delayed by 40 minutes.
Emma: That's frustrating. Do I still wait at Platform 6?
Jack: Actually, the platform has been changed to Platform 9. Please listen for updates.
Emma: Thank you for telling me.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我想买一张去北京的车票。
杰克：好的。您要坐高铁还是普通列车？
艾玛：高铁吧。下一班车几点发车？
杰克：下一班车10点30分从6号站台发车。
艾玛：太好了。能给我靠窗的座位吗？
杰克：当然。一共230元，现金还是刷卡？
艾玛：刷卡。
杰克：好的，这是您的车票，祝您旅途愉快。
艾玛：如果我错过了火车怎么办？
杰克：您可以到售票处改签晚一点的车次，只需支付少量手续费。
艾玛：谢谢。对了，10点半的车准点吗？
杰克：抱歉，刚有通知——列车晚点40分钟。
艾玛：真让人郁闷。我还在6号站台等吗？
杰克：其实站台已经改到9号了，请留意最新通知。
艾玛：谢谢您告诉我。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Excuse me, which line goes to the airport?
Jack: You need Line 2, and then transfer to the airport line at Central Station.
Emma: Where can I buy a metro card?
Jack: There's a ticket machine over there. You can also scan your phone to pay.
Emma: How do I transfer to Line 2?
Jack: Just follow the signs after you get off. It's about a five-minute walk.
Emma: Is this the right direction for the city center?
Jack: Yes, the next stop is the city center.
Emma: My metro card is almost empty. Where can I top it up?
Jack: There's a top-up machine at the next station.
Emma: Actually, the card got stuck in the machine just now.
Jack: Let me see. Oh, the chip looks damaged. I can issue you a new one.
Emma: Will I lose the money on it?
Jack: No, I'll transfer the balance to the new card for you. It'll take two minutes.
Emma: That's a relief. Thank you.
中文翻译:
艾玛：请问去机场坐哪条线？
杰克：您坐2号线，然后在中央车站换乘机场线。
艾玛：我在哪里可以买地铁卡？
杰克：那边有自动售票机，也可以用手机扫码支付。
艾玛：我该怎么换乘2号线？
杰克：下车后跟着指示牌走就行，大约步行五分钟。
艾玛：这是去市中心的方向吗？
杰克：是的，下一站就是市中心。
艾玛：我的地铁卡快没钱了，在哪里充值？
杰克：下一站有充值机。
艾玛：其实，刚才卡卡在机器里了。
杰克：我看看。哦，芯片好像坏了，我可以给您办一张新卡。
艾玛：卡里的钱会丢吗？
杰克：不会，我会把余额转到新卡上，大约两分钟。
艾玛：那就好，谢谢你。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Excuse me, does this bus go to the train station?
Jack: No, this one goes downtown. You need Bus 27.
Emma: How much is the fare?
Jack: Two yuan. You can scan the QR code or pay in cash.
Emma: Could you tell me when to get off?
Jack: Sure. I'll let you know when we arrive.
Emma: Thank you.
Jack: You're welcome. Please take a seat.
Emma: Could you remind me when we get to the museum?
Jack: Sure, I'll call it out when we arrive.
Emma: Why are we stopping here? I need to catch the train at 3.
Jack: There's a bad accident ahead. The road is completely blocked.
Emma: Oh no, I'll never make it in time!
Jack: Don't panic. We'll detour in five minutes, or you can get off and take the metro.
Emma: I'll get off here and run to the metro. Thanks for your help.
中文翻译:
艾玛：请问这路公交车到火车站吗？
杰克：不到，这路车去市中心，您要坐27路。
艾玛：车费多少钱？
杰克：两元，可以扫码也可以投币。
艾玛：到站时能告诉我一声吗？
杰克：好的，到站我会提醒您。
艾玛：谢谢。
杰克：不客气，请坐好。
艾玛：到博物馆时能提醒我一下吗？
杰克：好的，到站我会喊一声。
艾玛：我们怎么停在这里？我三点要赶火车。
杰克：前面出了严重事故，路完全堵死了。
艾玛：哎呀，我肯定赶不上了！
杰克：别慌，五分钟后我们会绕行，或者您可以下车去坐地铁。
艾玛：我就在这儿下车跑去地铁站。谢谢你的帮助。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Could you take me to this address, please?
Jack: No problem. Please get in.
Emma: How much will it cost to the airport?
Jack: About 120 yuan, plus the highway toll.
Emma: Okay. Is there a traffic jam ahead?
Jack: A little. But we'll still get there in about ten minutes.
Emma: Here we are. How much?
Jack: That'll be 150 yuan with the toll.
Emma: Wait, you said about 120 plus toll. The meter already shows 150.
Jack: I'm sorry, the toll was 30, and we hit the evening rush on the way.
Emma: That seems high. Could I have a receipt?
Jack: Of course. Here you go. Have a nice day.
Emma: Oh no, my phone charger is missing — it was on the back seat.
Jack: Wait, let me look. Yes, here it is, under the seat.
Emma: Thank goodness. Thanks so much.
中文翻译:
艾玛：请带我去这个地址好吗？
杰克：没问题，请上车。
艾玛：去机场要多少钱？
杰克：大概120元，再加上高速费。
艾玛：好的。前面堵车吗？
杰克：有一点，不过大约十分钟还是能到。
艾玛：到了，多少钱？
杰克：加上高速费一共150元。
艾玛：等等，你说大概120加高速费。计价器已经显示150了。
杰克：抱歉，高速费30元，而且路上碰上了晚高峰。
艾玛：好像有点贵。能给我发票吗？
杰克：当然。给您，祝您愉快。
艾玛：哎呀，我的手机充电器不见了——刚才放在后座上。
杰克：等等，我找找。有的，在座位下面。
艾玛：谢天谢地。太感谢了。

英文情景对话:
Emma: I'd like to rent a car for three days.
Jack: Sure. May I see your passport and driver's license?
Emma: Here you are. Do you have automatic cars?
Jack: Yes, we do. What size would you prefer?
Emma: A compact one is fine. Where do I return the car?
Jack: You can return it to any of our branches. Full insurance is included.
Emma: Great. What's the daily rate?
Jack: It's 60 dollars a day. Please sign here.
Emma: What if the car breaks down on the road?
Jack: Call our 24-hour hotline, and we'll send a replacement car.
Emma: Hi, I'm back to return the car. Uh, there's a new scratch on the door.
Jack: Let me inspect it. Yes, this scratch looks new. Do you remember how?
Emma: I parked on a narrow street yesterday and someone must have hit it.
Jack: Since you have full insurance, you won't be charged. Just fill out this form.
Emma: Thank goodness. I was so worried.
中文翻译:
艾玛：我想租三天车。
杰克：好的。请出示您的护照和驾照。
艾玛：给您。有自动挡的车吗？
杰克：有的。您想要什么车型？
艾玛：小型车就行。我在哪里还车？
杰克：您可以在我们任何一家门店还车，已含全险。
艾玛：好的。日租金多少钱？
杰克：每天60美元，请在这里签字。
艾玛：如果路上车坏了怎么办？
杰克：拨打我们的24小时热线，我们会派替换车辆。
艾玛：你好，我来还车。呃，车门上有一道新划痕。
杰克：我检查一下。是的，这道划痕看起来是新的。您记得怎么弄的吗？
艾玛：昨天我停在一条窄街上，肯定是被别人蹭到了。
杰克：因为您有全险，不需要您赔偿。请填这张表就行。
艾玛：谢天谢地，我刚才担心死了。

英文情景对话:
Emma: How much is a one-way ticket to the island?
Jack: It's 25 yuan per person.
Emma: When does the last ferry leave?
Jack: The last ferry leaves at 6:30 p.m.
Emma: How long is the crossing?
Jack: About 40 minutes. Enjoy your trip!
Emma: Is the ferry cancelled when the weather is bad?
Jack: Only in strong winds. We'll make an announcement in advance.
Emma: Excuse me, I just heard the horn — is the crossing smooth today?
Jack: I'm sorry, but the last ferry has been cancelled. The wind just picked up.
Emma: What? Then how do I get back to the mainland tonight?
Jack: There's no boat tonight. The next one leaves tomorrow at 8 a.m.
Emma: But I have a meeting tomorrow morning!
Jack: You could try the high-speed catamaran on the south pier — it might still run.
Emma: Thank you, I'll head there right away.
中文翻译:
艾玛：去那座岛的单程票多少钱？
杰克：每人25元。
艾玛：最后一班轮渡几点开？
杰克：最后一班下午6点30分开。
艾玛：航程要多久？
杰克：大约40分钟，祝您旅途愉快！
艾玛：天气不好时渡轮会停航吗？
杰克：只有大风天才会，我们会提前通知。
艾玛：请问，我刚听到汽笛——今天的航程正常吗？
杰克：很抱歉，最后一班轮渡已经取消了，风刚刚变大。
艾玛：什么？那我今晚怎么回大陆？
杰克：今晚没有船了，下一班明早8点开。
艾玛：可我明天上午还有个会议！
杰克：您可以去南码头试试高速双体船——这种风下它可能还会开。
艾玛：谢谢你，我这就过去。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello. I have a reservation under the name of Li.
Jack: Good evening. Could I see your passport, please?
Emma: Here you are.
Jack: Thank you. Let me pull up your reservation. I'm sorry, ma'am, we seem to have overbooked.
Emma: What do you mean? I booked a room two weeks ago!
Jack: I'm very sorry. Our system double-booked. We'll move you to our partner hotel next door.
Emma: Will it cost me more?
Jack: No, same rate, and we'll cover the taxi. Here's a free breakfast voucher as an apology.
Emma: I hope so. Also, could I have a room with a sea view?
Jack: Let me check. Yes, we have one on the 15th floor of the partner hotel.
Emma: Thank you. What time is breakfast at the new hotel?
Jack: Breakfast is served from 7 to 10 a.m. You're all set. Here's your new room key.
Emma: Okay, thank you for arranging it.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我用李这个名字预订了房间。
杰克：晚上好，请出示您的护照好吗？
艾玛：给您。
杰克：谢谢。我查一下您的预订。很抱歉，女士，我们好像超售了。
艾玛：什么意思？我两周前就订房了！
杰克：非常抱歉，我们系统重复预订了。我们把您安排到隔壁的合作酒店。
艾玛：会多收钱吗？
杰克：不会，价格一样，出租车费我们承担。这是一份免费早餐券，表示歉意。
艾玛：好吧。另外，能给我一间海景房吗？
杰克：我查一下。有的，合作酒店15楼还有一间海景房。
艾玛：谢谢。新酒店的早餐几点？
杰克：早餐7点到10点供应。您都安排好了，这是新的房卡。
艾玛：好的，谢谢你的安排。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Good morning. I'd like to check out, please.
Jack: Good morning. Could I have your room key, please?
Emma: Here it is. Could I have the bill, please?
Jack: Certainly. That'll be 1,650 yuan in total.
Emma: Wait, I only stayed two nights. Shouldn't it be 1,100?
Jack: Let me check. Ah, there's a charge of 550 for minibar drinks.
Emma: But I never touched the minibar! Could you double-check?
Jack: Of course. Let me call housekeeping. I'm so sorry, it was charged to the wrong room.
Emma: Thank you. That's a relief.
Jack: The corrected total is 1,100 yuan. How would you like to pay?
Emma: By card, please. Could I leave my luggage here? My train isn't until evening.
Jack: No problem. The luggage room is free of charge.
Emma: Could you call a taxi for me, please?
Jack: Sure, I'll call one right now. It'll be here in five minutes.
中文翻译:
艾玛：早上好，我想办理退房。
杰克：早上好，请把房卡给我好吗？
艾玛：给您。请给我账单好吗？
杰克：好的，一共1650元。
艾玛：等等，我只住了两晚，应该是1100元才对吧？
杰克：我查一下。啊，有一笔550元的迷你吧饮品消费。
艾玛：可我根本没动过迷你吧！你能再核对一下吗？
杰克：当然。我打电话给客房部。非常抱歉，这是记到了错误的房间。
艾玛：谢谢，那就好。
杰克：修正后一共1100元。您怎么付款？
艾玛：刷卡。我能把行李寄存在这里吗？我的火车要晚上才开。
杰克：没问题，行李房是免费的。
艾玛：能帮我叫一辆出租车吗？
杰克：好的，我马上叫，五分钟后到。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello, this is Room 508. The air conditioner isn't working.
Jack: I'm sorry to hear that. We'll send someone to fix it right away.
Emma: Could you also check the light in the bathroom?
Jack: Of course. Is there anything else?
Emma: Could I have an extra towel, please?
Jack: Sure, I'll bring it to your room within ten minutes.
Emma: Thank you. Oh, and the hot water stopped ten minutes ago.
Jack: I'm very sorry. It's a building-wide issue. We're fixing it and expect it back in 20 minutes.
Emma: Also, the room above is very loud. It's almost midnight.
Jack: Let me call them to keep it down. If it continues, we can move you to a quieter room.
Emma: Thank you. Please also bring a new TV remote — the old one isn't working.
Jack: I'll bring it along with the towel. We're sorry for the inconvenience.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我是508房间的。空调坏了。
杰克：非常抱歉，我们马上派人去维修。
艾玛：能顺便检查一下卫生间的灯吗？
杰克：当然。还有其他问题吗？
艾玛：能再给我一条毛巾吗？
杰克：好的，十分钟内送到您房间。
艾玛：谢谢。还有，热水十分钟前停了。
杰克：非常抱歉，这是整栋楼的问题。我们正在处理，预计20分钟内恢复。
艾玛：另外，我楼上的房间特别吵，都快半夜了。
杰克：我这就打电话让他们小声点。如果还是不行，我们可以把您换到更安静的房间。
艾玛：谢谢。请顺便送一个新的电视遥控器——旧的坏了。
杰克：我会和毛巾一起给您送一个新的。给您带来不便我们很抱歉。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hi, I've checked in online. What's the Wi-Fi password?
Jack: Welcome! The Wi-Fi password is on the card by the TV.
Emma: Great. How do I use the washing machine?
Jack: It's in the laundry room. Just add detergent and press start.
Emma: Is there a supermarket nearby?
Jack: Yes, there's one just around the corner, open until 10 p.m.
Emma: Perfect. Is the door code the same as the Wi-Fi password?
Jack: No, the door code is 1234.
Emma: Hi, the Wi-Fi keeps cutting out every few minutes.
Jack: Sorry about that. Let me restart the router remotely. It should be stable now.
Emma: Also, it's freezing in here. The heater doesn't blow warm air.
Jack: Oh, you need to set the mode to "heat," not "cool." Try 25 degrees.
Emma: That worked. Thanks for your help!
Jack: You're welcome. Enjoy your stay!
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我已经在线办理入住。Wi-Fi密码是什么？
杰克：欢迎！Wi-Fi密码在电视旁边的卡片上。
艾玛：好的。洗衣机怎么用？
杰克：洗衣机在洗衣房里，放好洗衣液按下启动键就行。
艾玛：附近有超市吗？
杰克：有，拐角处就有一家，营业到晚上10点。
艾玛：太好了。门锁密码和Wi-Fi密码一样吗？
杰克：不一样，门锁密码是1234。
艾玛：你好，Wi-Fi每隔几分钟就断一次。
杰克：抱歉，我远程重启一下路由器。现在应该稳定了。
艾玛：还有，这里面冷飕飕的，暖气好像不出热风。
杰克：哦，您需要把模式调到"制热"而不是"制冷"。试试25度。
艾玛：好了，谢谢你的帮助！
杰克：不客气，祝您住得愉快！

英文情景对话:
Emma: Excuse me, where can I find the dairy products?
Jack: They're at the back of the store, next to the frozen section.
Emma: Thanks. Do you have any discounts today?
Jack: Yes, milk and bread are 20% off today.
Emma: Great. I'd like to pay by card.
Jack: Sure, you can use the self-checkout over there.
Emma: Excuse me, the shelf says this cereal is on sale, but the scanner shows full price.
Jack: Let me check. You're right, the label wasn't updated. I'll adjust the price for you.
Emma: Thank you. Also, do you still have any skim milk? I don't see any.
Jack: Let me check the back storage. I'm sorry, we just sold out. More tomorrow morning.
Emma: Okay, I'll take the whole milk then.
Jack: No problem. Anything else?
Emma: No, that's all. Thanks.
中文翻译:
艾玛：请问乳制品在哪里？
杰克：在超市最里面，冷冻区旁边。
艾玛：谢谢。今天有什么折扣吗？
杰克：有的，今天牛奶和面包打八折。
艾玛：太好了。我想刷卡付款。
杰克：好的，您可以用那边的自助收银台。
艾玛：你好，货架上写着这款麦片在打折，但扫码显示的是原价。
杰克：我查一下。您说得对，标签没更新。我按促销价给您结算。
艾玛：谢谢。另外，还有脱脂牛奶吗？我没看到。
杰克：我去后面仓库看看。抱歉，刚卖完，明早补货。
艾玛：好吧，那我拿全脂奶。
杰克：好的。还需要别的吗？
艾玛：不用了，就这些，谢谢。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Excuse me, where is the fitting room?
Jack: It's right behind the cashier.
Emma: Do you have this in a larger size?
Jack: Let me check. Yes, we have it in large. Would you like to try it on?
Emma: Yes, please. How much is this?
Jack: It's 299 yuan, but there's a 10% discount this week.
Emma: Can I return this if it doesn't fit?
Jack: Yes, within 7 days with the receipt.
Emma: Hi, I'd like to return this jacket. The zipper broke the first time I wore it.
Jack: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?
Emma: Yes, here it is. It's been five days.
Jack: The return window is 7 days, so you're still within it. Let me process a full refund.
Emma: Thank you. Do you offer gift wrapping?
Jack: Yes, it's free at the customer service counter.
Emma: Great, thanks.
中文翻译:
艾玛：请问试衣间在哪里？
杰克：就在收银台后面。
艾玛：这个有大一号的吗？
杰克：我看看。有的，我们有L码，您要试一下吗？
艾玛：好的。这件多少钱？
杰克：299元，这周打九折。
艾玛：如果不合身可以退吗？
杰克：可以，凭小票7天内可退。
艾玛：你好，这件外套我想退。我第一次穿拉链就坏了。
杰克：很抱歉。您带小票了吗？
艾玛：带了，给你。才买了五天。
杰克：退货期是7天，您还在范围内。我给您全额退款。
艾玛：谢谢。你们提供礼品包装吗？
杰克：提供的，在服务台免费包装。
艾玛：太好了，谢谢。

英文情景对话:
Emma: A bottle of water and a pack of tissues, please.
Jack: Sure. That'll be 6.5 yuan.
Emma: Do you sell phone chargers here?
Jack: Yes, we have them by the counter. Which type do you need?
Emma: USB-C, please.
Jack: Here you are. Anything else?
Emma: No, that's all.
Jack: That'll be 46.5 yuan in total.
Emma: Hmm, my card keeps declining. Could you try again?
Jack: Sure. It's still declined. Would you like to pay by cash?
Emma: I don't have enough cash. Wait, let me try mobile payment. There, it went through.
Jack: Perfect. Oh, and this yogurt in your basket expired yesterday.
Emma: Really? Thanks for telling me. I'll put it back.
Jack: No problem. Have a nice day.
中文翻译:
艾玛：请给我一瓶水和一包纸巾。
杰克：好的，一共6块5。
艾玛：你们这里卖手机充电器吗？
杰克：卖的，在柜台旁边，您需要哪种接口的？
艾玛：USB-C的。
杰克：给您，还需要别的吗？
艾玛：不用了，就这些。
杰克：一共46块5。
艾玛：咦，我的卡一直刷不过。能再试一次吗？
杰克：好的。还是不行。您能付现金吗？
艾玛：我现金不够。等等，我试试手机支付。好了，付成功了。
杰克：好的。对了，您篮子里这盒酸奶昨天就过期了。
艾玛：真的吗？谢谢你告诉我，我放回去。
杰克：不客气，祝您愉快。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello, I have a headache. Could I get some painkillers?
Jack: Of course. Do you have any allergies?
Emma: No, I don't. How many times a day should I take this?
Jack: Take one tablet every six hours, after meals.
Emma: Do I need a prescription for this?
Jack: No, this one is over-the-counter.
Emma: Will this medicine make me sleepy?
Jack: It might. Please don't drive after taking it.
Emma: Actually, I also need this cold medicine — do you have it?
Jack: Let me check. I'm sorry, that brand is out of stock today.
Emma: Oh no. Is there an alternative with the same ingredients?
Jack: Yes, this generic brand has the same active ingredient. Would you like it?
Emma: Sure, thanks. How much is everything?
Jack: 15 yuan for the painkillers and 18 for the cold medicine. Get well soon.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我头疼，能给我一些止痛药吗？
杰克：当然。您有过敏史吗？
艾玛：没有。这个一天吃几次？
杰克：每六小时吃一片，饭后服用。
艾玛：这个需要处方吗？
杰克：不需要，这是非处方药。
艾玛：这个药会让人犯困吗？
杰克：可能会，服药后请不要开车。
艾玛：其实我还需要这种感冒药——你们有吗？
杰克：我查一下。抱歉，这个牌子今天没货了。
艾玛：哎呀。有成分相同的替代品吗？
杰克：有的，这款仿制药成分一样。您要吗？
艾玛：好的，谢谢。一共多少钱？
杰克：止痛药15元，感冒药18元。早日康复。

英文情景对话:
Emma: How much is this?
Jack: It's 50 yuan.
Emma: That's a bit expensive. Could you give me a better price?
Jack: Okay, for you, 40 yuan. That's the best I can do.
Emma: Deal. I'll take two of these.
Jack: Great, that'll be 80 yuan total.
Emma: Could you wrap them separately? They're gifts.
Jack: Of course, no extra charge.
Emma: Wait, this one has a crack on the bottom. Do you have another in better shape?
Jack: Let me see. You're right. Here, this one is perfect.
Emma: Thank you. Also, you said 40 each, but it looks like you charged me 50.
Jack: I'm sorry, I miscalculated. Here's 20 yuan back.
Emma: Thanks. Have a good day.
中文翻译:
艾玛：这个怎么卖？
杰克：50元。
艾玛：有点贵，能便宜点吗？
杰克：好吧，给你40元，这已经是最低价了。
艾玛：成交，这两个我都要了。
杰克：好的，一共80元。
艾玛：能分开包装吗？是送人的礼物。
杰克：当然可以，不加钱。
艾玛：等等，这个底部有一道裂纹。还有品相好一点的吗？
杰克：我看看。您说得对。给，这个完好。
艾玛：谢谢。另外，你不是说40元一个吗，好像收了我50。
杰克：抱歉，我算错了，这是找您的20元。
艾玛：谢谢，祝你生意好。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello, a table for two, please.
Jack: Sure. Right this way. Here's the menu.
Emma: Thanks. What do you recommend?
Jack: Our grilled fish is very popular, and today's special is beef noodles.
Emma: I'm allergic to peanuts. Does the grilled fish contain any?
Jack: No, it doesn't. I'll make a note for the kitchen.
Emma: Great.
Jack: Here is your grilled fish and your beef noodles.
Emma: Excuse me, I ordered the grilled fish — this looks like steamed fish.
Jack: I'm so sorry, that's our mistake. I'll bring the right one immediately.
Emma: Thank you.
Jack: Here's the correct order.
Emma: Wait, there's a hair in the soup.
Jack: Oh my goodness, I'm terribly sorry. I'll bring a fresh bowl, on the house.
Emma: Thank you. Please also pack the leftover noodles to go.
Jack: Sure, I'll pack it. Card or cash?
Emma: Card, please.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，请给我一张两人桌。
杰克：好的，这边请。这是菜单。
艾玛：谢谢。你有什么推荐的？
杰克：我们的烤鱼很受欢迎，今天的主厨推荐是牛肉面。
艾玛：我对花生过敏，烤鱼里有花生吗？
杰克：没有，我会跟厨房说明。
艾玛：太好了。
杰克：这是您的烤鱼和牛肉面。
艾玛：打扰一下，我点的是烤鱼——这看起来是清蒸鱼。
杰克：非常抱歉，是我们搞错了。我马上给您换一份对的。
艾玛：谢谢。
杰克：这是正确的菜。
艾玛：等等，汤里有一根头发。
杰克：哎呀，实在对不起。我马上换一碗新的，这碗我们免单。
艾玛：谢谢。另外把剩下的牛肉面打包。
杰克：好的，我帮您打包。刷卡还是现金？
艾玛：刷卡。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hi, a latte and a croissant, please.
Jack: For here or to go?
Emma: To go, please. Could I get it with oat milk?
Jack: Sure, oat milk is an extra 5 yuan. Anything else?
Emma: No, that's all. How much is it?
Jack: That'll be 38 yuan.
Emma: Actually, I'd like to add a piece of cake.
Jack: Sure. Chocolate or cheese?
Emma: Chocolate, please.
Jack: Sorry, we just ran out of oat milk. Would soy milk be okay?
Emma: Hmm, I'm allergic to soy. Could I just have regular milk then?
Jack: Of course. No extra charge this time.
Emma: Thank you. Oh wait, this is a cappuccino, not a latte.
Jack: Let me remake it right away. Sorry about that.
Emma: No worries. Thanks.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，请给我一杯拿铁和一个可颂。
杰克：堂食还是带走？
艾玛：带走。能换成燕麦奶吗？
杰克：可以，燕麦奶加5元。还需要别的吗？
艾玛：不用了。多少钱？
杰克：一共38元。
艾玛：对了，我想再加一块蛋糕。
杰克：好的，巧克力还是芝士的？
艾玛：巧克力的。
杰克：抱歉，燕麦奶刚用完。豆奶可以吗？
艾玛：嗯，我对大豆过敏。那就普通牛奶吧。
杰克：好的，这次不加钱。
艾玛：谢谢。等等，这是卡布奇诺，不是拿铁。
杰克：我马上给您重做一杯，抱歉。
艾玛：没关系，谢谢。

英文情景对话:
Emma: I'd like a cheeseburger and a large fries, please.
Jack: Sure. Would you like anything to drink?
Emma: A cola, please.
Jack: For here or takeaway?
Emma: Takeaway, please.
Jack: That'll be 45 yuan. Please wait about three minutes.
Emma: Could I get some extra ketchup?
Jack: Sure, it's free at the condiment station.
Emma: Excuse me, my order has been "almost ready" for 15 minutes.
Jack: I'm very sorry, we're short-staffed. Let me check. It should be out in a minute.
Emma: Thank you.
Jack: Here's your order.
Emma: Wait, I asked for a large fries — this is a small.
Jack: I'm sorry, let me swap it for a large. Here's a free apple pie as an apology.
Emma: Thank you, that's kind.
中文翻译:
艾玛：我要一个芝士汉堡和大份薯条。
杰克：好的。您想喝点什么吗？
艾玛：一杯可乐。
杰克：堂食还是带走？
艾玛：带走。
杰克：一共45元，请稍等大约三分钟。
艾玛：能多给我一些番茄酱吗？
杰克：好的，调料台有免费的。
艾玛：你好，我的订单已经"快好了"等了15分钟了。
杰克：非常抱歉，我们现在人手不够。我查一下，马上就好。
艾玛：谢谢。
杰克：这是您的餐。
艾玛：等等，我要的是大份薯条——这是小份。
杰克：抱歉，我马上换大份。这是一份免费苹果派，算我们赔礼。
艾玛：谢谢，你们真好。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello, could I order delivery, please?
Jack: Sure. What would you like to order?
Emma: One fried rice and one spring roll set, please.
Jack: Got it. What's your delivery address?
Emma: 15 Park Street, Building 3, Room 502.
Jack: Great. Your order will arrive in about 30 minutes.
Emma: It's been 50 minutes. Where is my order?
Jack: Let me check. I'm sorry, the rider is stuck in heavy rain. Another 10 minutes.
Emma: I'm really hungry. Okay, please hurry.
Jack: Thank you for your patience.
Emma: Hmm, this is not what I ordered — I got noodles instead of fried rice.
Jack: I'm so sorry! We'll send the correct order right away, free. You can keep the noodles.
Emma: That's very kind. Thank you.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我可以点外卖吗？
杰克：当然。您想点什么？
艾玛：一份炒饭和一份春卷套餐。
杰克：好的。您的送餐地址是？
艾玛：公园街15号，3栋502室。
杰克：好的。您的订单大约30分钟后送达。
艾玛：已经50分钟了，我的外卖到哪了？
杰克：我查一下。抱歉，骑手遇上大雨堵在路上，还要再等10分钟。
艾玛：我都饿死了。好吧，请快点。
杰克：感谢您的耐心。
艾玛：咦，这不是我点的——我收到的是面条，不是炒饭。
杰克：非常抱歉！我们马上免费重送一份对的，面条您留着吃。
艾玛：你们真好，谢谢。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment with a doctor.
Jack: Sure. What seems to be the problem?
Emma: I have a fever and a sore throat.
Jack: How long have you had these symptoms?
Emma: Since yesterday.
Jack: Okay, I'll book you for Dr. Chen at 3 p.m. today. Please arrive 15 minutes early.
Emma: Can I use my insurance here?
Jack: Yes, please bring your insurance card.
Emma: (after seeing the doctor) Hi, I'm here to pick up my medicine.
Jack: Let me check. I'm sorry, this antibiotic is out of stock today.
Emma: What? Then what should I do?
Jack: The doctor prescribed a substitute. Here, take this one instead.
Emma: Will it work the same?
Jack: Yes, it's equivalent. Take it three times a day after meals.
Emma: Thank you. Where do I pay?
Jack: At window 2. Feel better soon.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我想预约看医生。
杰克：好的。您哪里不舒服？
艾玛：我发烧而且嗓子疼。
杰克：这些症状持续多久了？
艾玛：从昨天开始的。
杰克：好的，我给您约今天下午3点陈医生的号，请提前15分钟到。
艾玛：这里能用我的保险吗？
杰克：可以，来的时候请带上保险卡。
艾玛：（看完医生后）你好，我来取药。
杰克：我查一下。抱歉，这种抗生素今天没货了。
艾玛：什么？那我怎么办？
杰克：医生开了替代药。给，改吃这种。
艾玛：药效一样吗？
杰克：一样的，是等效药物。请一天三次饭后服用。
艾玛：谢谢。在哪里缴费？
杰克：2号窗口。早日康复。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Help! Call an ambulance, please!
Jack: Stay calm. What's your location?
Emma: 20 Garden Street, in front of the supermarket.
Jack: Got it. Is the patient conscious?
Emma: Yes, but he has chest pain.
Jack: An ambulance is on its way. Keep him lying still.
Emma: Thank you so much. How long will it take?
Jack: About five minutes. Please stay with him and keep him calm.
Emma: (at ER) Hi, we've waited 30 minutes and he's getting worse.
Jack: I'm sorry. We're very short-staffed today. Let me triage him now.
Emma: His pain is spreading to his left arm!
Jack: I see the urgency. Follow me — he goes straight into treatment.
Emma: Thank you.
Jack: No need. Go with him.
中文翻译:
艾玛：救命！请叫救护车！
杰克：请保持冷静。您在哪里？
艾玛：花园街20号，超市门口。
杰克：明白了。病人有意识吗？
艾玛：有意识，但他胸口疼。
杰克：救护车已经在路上了，让他保持平躺别动。
艾玛：太感谢了。救护车多久能到？
杰克：大约五分钟，请陪着他，让他保持平静。
艾玛：（在急诊室）你好，我们已经等了30分钟，他情况越来越糟。
杰克：抱歉，我们今天人手非常紧。我这就给他分诊。
艾玛：他的疼痛蔓延到左臂了！
杰克：情况紧急，跟我来——他直接进治疗室。
艾玛：谢谢你。
杰克：不用谢，陪他进去吧。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello, I'd like to have a medical check-up.
Jack: Sure. Basic or comprehensive package?
Emma: The comprehensive one. Do I need to fast before the blood test?
Jack: Yes, don't eat or drink for at least 8 hours before your appointment.
Emma: Got it. When can I get the results?
Jack: In about three working days. We'll call you.
Emma: Do I need to bring anything else?
Jack: Just your ID card. The check-up takes about an hour.
Emma: Hi, I'm here to get my results.
Jack: Let me pull them up. I'm afraid your fasting blood sugar is higher than normal.
Emma: Oh no, is it serious?
Jack: It's borderline. Please see a doctor to confirm. We'll schedule a free follow-up test.
Emma: Thank you for letting me know.
Jack: You're welcome. Keep a normal diet and avoid sweets.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我想做一次体检。
杰克：好的。您要基础套餐还是全面套餐？
艾玛：全面的。抽血前需要空腹吗？
杰克：需要，请预约前至少8小时不要进食饮水。
艾玛：明白了。结果什么时候能出来？
杰克：大约三个工作日，我们会电话通知您。
艾玛：还需要带别的吗？
杰克：带身份证就行。体检大约需要一个小时。
艾玛：你好，我来取报告。
杰克：我调一下。您的空腹血糖偏高。
艾玛：哎呀，严重吗？
杰克：处于临界值。请去看医生确认一下，我们可以免费安排一次复查。
艾玛：谢谢你告诉我。
杰克：不客气。保持正常饮食，少吃甜食。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello, this is Li speaking. Could I speak to Mr. Wang, please?
Jack: I'm sorry, he's in a meeting right now. Would you like to leave a message?
Emma: Yes, could you tell him I called? I'll call back later.
Jack: Sure. May I have your number?
Emma: It's 138-1234-5678. Thanks.
Jack: No problem. I'll pass the message on.
Emma: (calling back) Hi, it's Li again. Sorry, my phone died mid-call last time.
Jack: No problem. I said the meeting is moved to 3 p.m.
Emma: The line is bad. Could you say that again?
Jack: Sure. The meeting is moved to 3 p.m., not 2 p.m.
Emma: Got it. We got cut off — can you hear me now?
Jack: Yes, loud and clear. See you at 3.
Emma: Great, thanks.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我是小李。请找王先生接电话好吗？
杰克：抱歉，他正在开会。您需要留言吗？
艾玛：好的，请告诉他我来过电话，我稍后再打。
杰克：好的。能留一下您的号码吗？
艾玛：我的号码是138-1234-5678，谢谢。
杰克：没问题，我会转告他。
艾玛：（回拨）你好，我是小李。抱歉，刚才通话中我手机关机了。
杰克：没关系。我说会议改到下午3点了。
艾玛：信号不好，能再说一遍吗？
杰克：好的，会议改到下午3点，不是2点。
艾玛：明白了。我们断了——现在能听到吗？
杰克：能，现在很清楚。3点见。
艾玛：好的，谢谢。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello, I'd like to send this parcel to China.
Jack: Sure. What's inside, please?
Emma: Some books and clothes. How much is the postage?

中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，能给我一张城市地图吗？

英文情景对话:
Emma: Two adult tickets, please.
Jack: That'll be 120 yuan. Do you have any student ID?

Emma: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?
Jack: Go straight ahead and turn left at the second traffic light.

中文翻译:

艾玛：谢谢。下周一我能请一天假吗？
杰克：应该可以，跟工头提交一份请假申请就行。
艾玛：明天下午你能帮我顶班吗？
杰克：可以，把细节发给我就行。
艾玛：喂，电钻干到一半停了。
杰克：我看看。电池没电了。工具箱里有备用电池。
艾玛：谢谢。另外，我明天可能得请病假——嗓子疼死了。
杰克：去休息吧，我替你，没问题。
艾玛：谢谢，欠你个人情。
杰克：没事，队友嘛。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Safety first. Wear your helmet at all times.
Jack: Got it. I've put mine on already.
Emma: Put on your safety gloves and goggles before handling the wires.
Jack: Okay, I'll get them right away.
Emma: This area is dangerous. Keep out.
Jack: Understood. We'll work from the other side.
Emma: There's a warning sign missing over there.
Jack: I'll put one up right now.
Jack: Ouch! I just scraped my arm on that sharp metal edge.
Emma: Are you okay? Let me see. It's a small cut. Let's get the first-aid kit.
Jack: It stings a bit.
Emma: That's why we require long sleeves on site. Let me clean and bandage it.
Jack: Sorry, I'll roll my sleeves down from now on.
Emma: Also, report it to the foreman so we can file an incident report.
中文翻译:
艾玛：安全第一，请全程佩戴安全帽。
杰克：明白，我已经戴好了。
艾玛：接触电线前请戴上安全手套和护目镜。
杰克：好的，我马上去拿。
艾玛：这个区域很危险，请勿进入。
杰克：明白了，我们改从另一边施工。
艾玛：那边少了一块警示牌。
杰克：我马上补一块。
杰克：哎哟！我胳膊刚被那片锋利的金属边划到了。
艾玛：你没事吧？我看看。小伤口，我们去拿急救箱。
杰克：有点刺疼。
艾玛：所以工地要求穿长袖。我来帮你清洗包扎一下。
杰克：抱歉，以后我把袖子放下来。
艾玛：另外，跟工头报备一下，我们要填一份事故记录。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hi, nice to meet you. I'm Li.
Jack: Nice to meet you too. I'm Sam.
Emma: Where are you from?
Jack: I'm from Sydney. What about you?
Emma: I'm from China. I just moved here.
Jack: Welcome! Let me know if you need any help.
Emma: Thank you.
Jack: Are you here for work or study?
Emma: I'm here for work. I'm an electrician.
Jack: Oh cool. Uh, sorry, what was your name again? I didn't catch it.
Emma: It's Li. L-I.
Jack: Sorry about that, Li. Nice to meet you!
Emma: Nice to meet you too, Sam.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，很高兴认识你。我是小李。
杰克：我也很高兴认识你，我是萨姆。
艾玛：你来自哪里？
杰克：我来自悉尼。你呢？
艾玛：我来自中国，刚搬到这里。
杰克：欢迎！有需要帮忙的尽管说。
艾玛：谢谢。
杰克：你是来工作的还是来学习的？
艾玛：我是来工作的，我是电工。
杰克：哦，挺好。呃，抱歉，你叫什么名字来着？我刚才没听清。
艾玛：我姓李，L-I。
杰克：不好意思，小李。很高兴认识你！
艾玛：我也很高兴认识你，萨姆。

英文情景对话:
Emma: How's the weather today?
Jack: It's sunny and warm, perfect for a walk.
Emma: What do you do for a living?
Jack: I'm a nurse. What about you?
Emma: I'm an electrician.
Jack: Cool. Do you have any hobbies?
Emma: I like fishing on weekends.
Jack: That sounds relaxing! How long have you lived here?
Emma: About five years. I really like this city.
Jack: Same here. Uh oh — look at those clouds. It's going to pour.
Emma: Really? I didn't bring an umbrella.
Jack: Me neither. Let's make a run for that café over there.
Emma: Good idea. We can talk again when the rain stops.
中文翻译:
艾玛：今天天气怎么样？
杰克：晴朗温暖，很适合散步。
艾玛：你是做什么工作的？
杰克：我是护士。你呢？
艾玛：我是电工。
杰克：很棒。你有什么爱好吗？
艾玛：我喜欢周末钓鱼。
杰克：听起来很放松！你在这里住多久了？
艾玛：大约五年了，我很喜欢这座城市。
杰克：我也是。哎呀——看那些云，要下大雨了。
艾玛：真的吗？我没带伞。
杰克：我也没带。我们快跑到那家咖啡馆吧。
艾玛：好主意，等雨停了再聊。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Are you free this weekend?
Jack: Yes, I should be free on Saturday.
Emma: Would you like to have dinner with me?
Jack: I'd love to. Let's meet at seven at the café.
Emma: Sounds good. Should I book the table?
Jack: Yes, please book it for seven under my name.
Emma: (Saturday afternoon) Hi, something came up at work. Can we push dinner to 7:30?
Jack: No problem. I'll update the reservation.
Emma: Thank you. Actually, a family emergency just popped up. Can we rain-check it?
Jack: Of course, no rush. Let's do it next weekend instead.
Emma: I really appreciate it. Sorry again.
Jack: Don't worry about it. Family comes first.
中文翻译:
艾玛：这周末你有空吗？
杰克：有空，周六应该可以。
艾玛：你愿意和我一起吃晚饭吗？
杰克：我很乐意。我们7点在咖啡馆见吧。
艾玛：好的。需要我订位吗？
杰克：好的，请以我的名义订7点的位子。
艾玛：（周六下午）你好，工作上有点事。我们能把晚饭改到7点半吗？
杰克：没问题，我去更新预订。
艾玛：谢谢。其实……家里突然有点急事，我们能改天吗？
杰克：当然，不急。下周再约吧。
艾玛：真的很感谢，再次抱歉。
杰克：别放在心上，家里的事要紧。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Excuse me, could you help me?
Jack: Of course. What can I do for you?
Emma: Could you do me a favor and hold this door?
Jack: No problem.
Emma: Thank you so much for your help.
Jack: You're welcome. Anytime.
Emma: Uh, could I also borrow your phone charger? My phone's at 1%.
Jack: Sure, here it is. The outlet is right behind you.
Emma: Thank you. Oh no, I think I dropped my wallet somewhere.
Jack: When was the last time you had it?
Emma: At the ticket counter. Let me check. Yes, here it is, on the bench.
Jack: Phew. Glad it turned up.
Emma: Me too. Thanks for everything.
中文翻译:
艾玛：打扰一下，你能帮我吗？
杰克：当然。我能帮你做什么？
艾玛：能帮我个忙，扶一下这扇门吗？
杰克：没问题。
艾玛：非常感谢你的帮助。
杰克：不客气，随时都可以。
艾玛：呃，其实，能再借一下你的手机充电器吗？我手机只剩1%了。
杰克：当然，给你。插座就在你身后。
艾玛：谢谢。哎呀，我的钱包好像掉哪儿了。
杰克：你最后一次看到它是什么时候？
艾玛：在售票窗口。我找找。对了，在长椅上。
杰克：呼。幸好找到了。
艾玛：是啊。谢谢你帮忙。

英文情景对话:
Emma: I think this plan is a good idea.
Jack: I agree with you.
Emma: What about moving the meeting to Friday?
Jack: I'm sorry, but I disagree. Thursday works better for me.
Emma: Why Thursday?
Jack: I have a client visit on Friday afternoon, so Thursday morning is better.
Emma: Hmm, but three other people said Friday works.
Jack: Could we do Thursday afternoon then? That way I can still see the client.
Emma: Let me check. Yes, Thursday 3 p.m. works for everyone.
Jack: Great. Do you have any other ideas?
Emma: We could also send a reminder email the day before.
Jack: Perfect. I'll draft it.
中文翻译:
艾玛：我觉得这个计划是个好主意。
杰克：我同意你的看法。
艾玛：把会议改到周五怎么样？
杰克：抱歉，我不同意。周四对我更合适。
艾玛：为什么选周四？
杰克：周五下午我要去见客户，所以周四上午更合适。
艾玛：嗯，但其他三个人说周五方便。
杰克：那我们定周四下午可以吗？这样我还能去见客户。
艾玛：我确认一下。可以，周四下午3点大家都方便。
杰克：好的。你还有其他想法吗？
艾玛：我们还可以前一天给大家发一封提醒邮件。
杰克：太好了，我来起草。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello, I'd like to apply for a work visa.
Jack: Certainly. May I see your passport and employment contract?
Emma: Here you are. What other documents do I need to provide?
Jack: You'll also need your qualifications and a health certificate.
Emma: I have my qualifications here. But I haven't done the health check yet.
Jack: That's fine. You have 14 days to submit it, or the application will be delayed.
Emma: How long does the visa processing take?
Jack: Usually about two weeks.
Emma: I see. Also, I'd like to extend my visa when it expires.
Jack: Sure. You can apply for an extension one month before it expires.
Emma: What's the application fee?
Jack: It's 150 dollars. Please pay at window 5.
Emma: Thank you.
Jack: You're welcome. Good luck.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我想申请工作签证。
杰克：好的。请出示您的护照和雇佣合同。
艾玛：给您。我还需要提供哪些材料？
杰克：您还需要学历证明和健康证明。
艾玛：学历证明我带了。但我还没做体检。
杰克：没关系，您有14天时间补交，否则申请会延误。
艾玛：签证办理需要多长时间？
杰克：通常大约两周。
艾玛：明白了。另外，签证到期时我想续签。
杰克：好的，您可以在签证到期前一个月申请续签。
艾玛：申请费是多少？
杰克：150美元，请到5号窗口缴费。
艾玛：谢谢。
杰克：不客气，祝顺利。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello, I'd like to report a lost passport.
Jack: I'm sorry to hear that. When and where did you lose it?
Emma: This morning at the train station. My wallet was stolen, too.
Jack: I see. Please fill out this report form with your details.
Emma: Could I get a copy of the police report?
Jack: Yes, we'll give you a copy for your embassy.
Emma: Thank you. Uh, my phone just died. Can I borrow your phone to call the embassy?
Jack: Sure, here you go.
Emma: (hangs up) They said to bring the report tomorrow. How long will it take you to finish it?
Jack: About 30 minutes. Please wait in the waiting area.
Emma: Okay, thank you for your help.
Jack: You're welcome. We'll contact you if we have any news.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我要报案，我的护照丢了。
杰克：很遗憾听到这个消息。您什么时候、在哪里丢的？
艾玛：今天早上在火车站，钱包也被偷了。
杰克：明白了。请填写这份报案表，写上您的详细信息。
艾玛：能给我一份报警记录副本吗？
杰克：可以，我们会给您一份副本，供大使馆使用。
艾玛：谢谢。呃，我手机刚没电了，能借你的电话打给大使馆吗？
杰克：当然，给你。
艾玛：（挂断后）他们说明天带报案记录去。你们多久能开好这份记录？
杰克：大约30分钟，请在等候区稍等。
艾玛：好的，谢谢你的帮助。
杰克：不客气，有消息我们会联系您。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hi, I'd like to sign up for a gym membership.
Jack: Sure. We have monthly and yearly plans.
Emma: How much is the monthly fee?
Jack: It's 50 dollars a month, or 480 a year.
Emma: I'll take the monthly plan. How do I use this machine?
Jack: It's a treadmill. Just set the speed here and press start.
Emma: Do you offer a free trial class?
Jack: Yes, the first class is free. Would you like to book one?
Emma: Sure.
Emma: (later) Hi, the treadmill I was using just stopped and won't restart.
Jack: Let me check. It's erroring out. Sorry, we've had issues with this one.
Emma: Can I switch to the bike next to it?
Jack: Of course. And here's a free water bottle for the trouble.
Emma: Thank you.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我想办一张健身卡。
杰克：好的。我们有月卡和年卡。
艾玛：月费是多少？
杰克：每月50美元，年卡480美元。
艾玛：我办月卡。这个器械怎么用？
杰克：这是跑步机，在这里设置速度，然后按启动键就行。
艾玛：你们有免费体验课吗？
杰克：有的，第一节课免费，您要预约吗？
艾玛：好的。
艾玛：（过了一会儿）你好，我用的那台跑步机刚停了，重启不了。
杰克：我看看。报错了，抱歉，这台老出问题。
艾玛：我能换旁边那台单车吗？
杰克：当然。这瓶水送您，算我们赔礼。
艾玛：谢谢。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hi, I'd like to get a haircut.
Jack: Sure. Please have a seat. How would you like it cut?
Emma: Please leave it a bit longer on top.
Jack: Got it. Short on the sides and longer on top. Anything else?
Emma: That's all. How much is it?
Jack: 30 dollars. Would you like a wash too?
Emma: Sure, that would be nice.
Jack: Okay, please lean back.
Emma: How long will the haircut take?
Jack: About 40 minutes for a cut and wash.
Jack: All done. Take a look.
Emma: Hmm, this is shorter than I asked for. I wanted it longer on top.
Jack: Oh, I'm sorry. Let me even it out — it'll still be a bit short, though.
Emma: It's okay, don't worry. It'll grow back.
Jack: Let me take 5 dollars off for my mistake.
Emma: Thank you, that's kind.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我想理发。
杰克：好的，请坐。您想怎么剪？
艾玛：头顶请留长一点。
杰克：明白了，两边剪短，头顶留长。还有别的吗？
艾玛：就这些。多少钱？
杰克：30美元。需要顺便洗个头吗？
艾玛：好啊，那挺好。
杰克：好的，请往后靠。
艾玛：剪发要多久？
杰克：剪加洗大约40分钟。
杰克：剪好了，您看看。
艾玛：嗯，比我要求的短了。我是想头顶留长一点。
杰克：啊，抱歉。我修匀一下——不过还是会偏短。
艾玛：没关系，别放心上，头发会长回来的。
杰克：这是我的失误，给您减5美元。
艾玛：谢谢，你们真好。

英文情景对话:
Emma: Hello, I'd like to get this suit dry-cleaned.
Jack: No problem. When would you like to pick it up?
Emma: Tomorrow afternoon. There's a stain on this shirt, by the way.
Jack: I'll treat the stain. It'll be ready by 4 p.m. tomorrow.
Emma: How much will it cost?
Jack: The suit is 20 dollars and the shirt is 8 dollars.
Emma: When exactly should I come back?
Jack: Anytime after 4 p.m. tomorrow.
Emma: (next day) Hi, I'm here to pick up my suit. Uh, there's a new tear on the sleeve.
Jack: Let me see. Oh no, that must have happened during cleaning. I'm so sorry.
Emma: It's my favorite suit.
Jack: We'll pay for the repair, and this cleaning is on the house. Here's our damage form.
Emma: Thank you. I appreciate that.
Jack: We'll call you when it's ready for pickup.
中文翻译:
艾玛：你好，我想干洗这套西装。
杰克：没问题。您想什么时候来取？
艾玛：明天下午。对了，这件衬衫上有个污渍。
杰克：我会重点处理这个污渍，明天下午4点前可以取。
艾玛：多少钱？
杰克：西装20美元，衬衫8美元。
艾玛：我具体什么时候来取？
杰克：明天下午4点以后随时可以。
艾玛：（第二天）你好，我来取西装。呃，袖子上多了一道破口。
杰克：我看看。哎呀，肯定是清洗时弄的，非常抱歉。
艾玛：这是我最喜欢的一套西装。
杰克：我们会赔偿修补费用，这次干洗免单。这是我们的衣物损坏处理表。
艾玛：谢谢，你们处理得很好。
杰克：修好后我们会打电话通知您来取。
